A1.justification: Both PDFs describe EditSplat and contain readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and supplementary Sections A-D. The retained material can be reliably matched across revisions.

before.justification: v1 reports original 3D editing experiments, CLIP evaluations, a 100-participant user study, and ablations in the main text and supplement.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results and adds qualitative sensitivity studies in supplementary Figures 10-11.

M1.justification: The MFG fusion and guidance procedure, AGT pruning and selective optimization, editing loss, and Algorithm 1 remain unchanged. The new parameter analyses do not introduce a different method.

E1.justification: Both versions use four IN2N scenes, one BlendedMVS scene, and three Mip-NeRF360 scenes, with the same evaluation prompts in Tables 2-3. The added sensitivity studies revisit existing face/paper and garden/autumn editing tasks.

E2.justification: The main comparisons retain GaussianEditor, GaussCtrl, and DGE. The supplementary comparison retains IN2N, VICA-NeRF, and WatchYourSteps, moving from Figure 12 to Figure 14.

E3.justification: New Figures 10-11 introduce qualitative sweeps over sM = 0.1, 1.0, 2.0 and wthres = 0.01, 0.1, 0.2. The existing benchmark split, metrics, training settings, default parameters, and user-study protocol remain unchanged.

E4.justification: v2 adds sensitivity analyses examining fusion guidance strength and the localization threshold. The existing MFG/AGT ablations and pruning-fraction analysis are retained; v1's pruning Figure 10 becomes v2's Figure 12.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The added sensitivity figures introduce no uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Figures 10-11 add qualitative results showing weaker editing with excessive fusion guidance and different preservation/editing outcomes across localization thresholds. Table 1 remains unchanged, including EditSplat's 0.1431 CLIP directional similarity, 0.2531 CLIP similarity, and 0.4227 user-study score.

T1.justification: The mathematical method definitions and supplementary conditional-probability, log-probability, and gradient derivations are retained. Renumbering the supplementary guidance equation and subsequent equations does not change their substance.

C1.justification: Both versions claim improved multi-view consistency, optimization efficiency, semantic local editing, and superiority over the evaluated methods. v2's state-of-the-art wording restates superiority already claimed in v1.

C2.justification: Section B.2 newly explains how excessive fusion guidance weakens text-driven editing. New Section C.3 explains why low localization thresholds modify unintended regions while high thresholds suppress desired edits. The existing diffusion-model and depth-quality limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The new sensitivity figures explicitly document the tested guidance-scale and localization-threshold values. Existing implementation instructions, hardware, training budgets, runtime, and project access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds TraME to the related-work citations and corrects the introduction's diffusion-training attribution from the perceptual-metric reference to ConsistDreamer. The overall positioning relative to earlier editing approaches is retained.

P1.justification: v2 locally rewrites the abstract, related work, hyperparameter explanation, and conclusion; adds acknowledgements and Section C.3; and updates author information. The overall narrative and section organization remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds Figures 10-11, updates the retained pruning figure's labels and caption, and adjusts supplementary figure numbering and placement. The principal comparison figures and table structures are preserved.

improvement.justification: v1 specified fusion-guidance and localization defaults without sensitivity studies for those parameters. v2's Figures 10-11 and Sections B.2/C.3 provide supporting examples and explain the associated failure modes, improving the justification and practical interpretation of these choices. The gain is limited because the added evidence is qualitative on existing tasks, while the main benchmark results and method remain unchanged.
